recipeSemantics.failurePrecedence: The named counter is varied while every other counter is held at or below its inclusive limit.
recipeSemantics.sourceNormalization: UTF-8 without BOM; CRLF and CR become LF; exactly one terminal LF

recipe.padding: Replace <padding> with exactly targetCounterValue minus the normalized UTF-8 byte count when <padding> is empty copies of paddingByte.
recipe.accounting: Count the complete normalized configured source file; handler AST remains excluded from metadata traversal and execution.

recipe.assignmentRule: For visit index i, contract index is i modulo contractCount and local ordinal is floor(i divided by contractCount).
recipe.accountingRule: Materialize exactly counterValue visit records; each record contributes exactly one language-neutral logical visit.
recipe.isolation: The projection has exactly 128 declaration-only contract buckets, no providers or local aliases, and shallow independent visits.
recipe.frontendMapping: Deferred: each frontend must publish and test its syntax/type/expression-node mapping against this logical stream before claiming source-limit conformance.

recipe.chainRule: Depth00 is the method request; each DepthNN record has one required next property referring to Depth(NN+1); the final definition has one required boolean value.
recipe.materializationRule: Materialize definitions Depth00 through Depth(counterValue-1), exactly counterValue definitions and counterValue-1 next references.
recipe.counterRule: counterValue is the number of entered language-neutral reference frames from the method request through the terminal definition
recipe.precedence: Apply the source traversal limit before candidate descriptor graph validation.

recipe.bindingRule: Each binding is a direct const initialized with s.string() and is used as one named definition value.
recipe.distribution: For binding index i, contract index is i modulo contractCount and local ordinal is floor(i divided by contractCount).
recipe.accountingRule: Materialize exactly counterValue uniquely indexed binding records and exactly one reference to each binding.
recipe.resolutionRule: Resolve every indexed binding exactly once while walking each contract's definition map in source order.
recipe.isolation: No providers or alias chains; traversal depth stays shallow and every descriptor stays below its independent schema-node limit.

recipe.contractTemplate: one public declaration-only unary service with named Unit and Result definitions and no local constants
recipe.accountingRule: Materialize contract indices 0 through counterValue-1; each complete contract contributes exactly one contract.

recipe.providerTemplate: one complete runtime provider with an explicit indexed provider ID for the same public unary contract
recipe.accountingRule: Materialize provider indices 0 through counterValue-1; each complete provider contributes exactly one local provider binding.
